Class TileFile

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.biop.cellpose.TileFile
public class TileFile extends Object
Holds the correspondence between a RegionRequest and a saved input tile image on disk, and infers the resulting Cellpose label ("mask") file name.

The public accessors are what the segmentation backends in qupath.ext.biop.cellpose.backend need; candidate storage stays package-private.
